name: vschat
description: Chat through WeChat iLink or QQ Bot directly in VSCode

vschat.renderMarkdown.description: Render Markdown in Chat and message context. Raw HTML and embedded Markdown images stay inert. Output and Changes modes remain plain text. Takes effect immediately.

enumDescriptions: Enter sends; Shift+Enter inserts a new line.
Ctrl+Enter or Cmd+Enter sends; Enter inserts a new line.
vschat.sendShortcut.description: Message send shortcut. Takes effect immediately. Input method composition never sends a message.

enumDescriptions: Use the official QQ Bot API v2 transport.
vschat.channel.description: Chat transport. Reload VS Code after changing this setting.

vschat.proxyUrl.description: HTTP proxy URL (e.g., http://proxy.example.com:8080). Leave empty to use system proxy.

vschat.fromUserId.description: Legacy WeChat contact hint. The chat panel requires an explicitly selected, discovered conversation and does not switch recipients based on this setting.

vschat.qqUserOpenId.description: Optional QQ OpenID candidate shown in the recipient selector. Select it explicitly; a usable passive reply context is required. This setting does not grant proactive-send permission or automatically change the current recipient.

vschat.barkUrl.description: Bark push URL for iPhone notifications. Use a base URL like https://api.day.app/YOUR_KEY/ or a template containing {title} and {message}. Leave empty to disable.

vschat.logLevel.description: Diagnostic log verbosity. Debug includes request timing and connection details but excludes credentials and message content.

vschat.autoUpdate.description: Automatically check GitHub Releases for VsChat updates and prompt to install.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle && npm run copy-wasm
